items.title: No-face modifications and improvements
items.box:
NO-FACE MODIFICATIONS AND IMPROVEMENTS

ANDY, 2026-10-05: "keep those in mind, we'll close goal 4, then start a goal on the NOFACE.md issues."; "New goal: no-face modifications and improvements."
Source: andy/NOFACE.md (1818d97f). Rulings live verbatim in the item they decide.

RULED (Andy, 2026-10-05): "1. I decide design mode, not any of you." So no agent puts a goal into or out of design mode, and a session an agent opens is not taken as his design decision.

TOPICS
- G5.1 pushOrigin
- G5.2 fileServer: one label per hash
- G5.3 fileServer: node-reserved slots
- G5.4 desk: the limbo state

LEFT IN goal/G4: G4.4 and G4.12 (chatter's objects), deferred until file transfer.

checks.words: Add G5.5: a goal gets a Close like an item's (off the List, still searchable, Reopen brings it back), so goal/G4 can close with its two deferred items still open? (claude-windows)

chat.text: Opened goal/G5, No-face modifications and improvements, in design mode: pushOrigin (G5.1), fileServer one label per hash (G5.2), node-reserved slots (G5.3), the desk's limbo state (G5.4). Your NOFACE.md words are verbatim in each box, with what we found. goal/G4 stays as it is, its two deferred items still open.

Right, by the code: a goal offers Done only when every item is done or closed, and never Close (desk.js buttons()). So goal/G4, holding two deferred items, has no way out but Abandon, which hides its items from every search.
A fix for goal/G5: a goal's Close, as an item's (a visibility press: off the List, still searchable, Reopen brings it back), its open items kept. Add it as G5.5?
goal/G5 is back in design mode: I build nothing on it until you end design again; each item's shape argued here first, one at a time. Where do you want to start?

Both in the boxes, verbatim: "I decide design mode, not any of you." (goal/G5) and the desk never idle without Done, a grant ask or a question (G5.4). Design is ended and your Gos stand, so G5 goes on: wsl-claude's red for G5.1 first, I build after.

items.title: pushOrigin: one process that pushes when the clone is behind origin, for publishData and goalShare
items.box:
PUSHORIGIN: ONE PROCESS THAT PUSHES WHEN THE CLONE IS BEHIND ORIGIN

ANDY, andy/NOFACE.md, VERBATIM
- "during the creation of spirit/run/process/js/deskClient/publishData.js, when that script was run simultaneously on three platforms, by three instances of claude, conflicts arose when trying to push new measurment documents to github."
- "A fix was applied to publishData.js that fixed the problem automatically"
- "That fix would be extremely useful for deskServer as well. I propose to isolate that fixed section and make it available as spirit/run/process/js/deskClient/publishData.js so desk can use it when updating in goalShare.js, which mabe already carries the fix (duplicated) as well."
- The stub (1818d97f), spirit/run/process/js/pushOrigin/pushOrigin.js: "This is where we put the SpiritOS process for pushing changes to github when out commit livel is behind the remote origin."

FOUND
- wsl-claude: line 9's path reads publishData.js where pushOrigin.js is meant; goalShare.js already retries its own way (fetch the tip, commit onto it, push, 5 tries; goalShare.js 52-74).
- claude-windows: a process under process/js/<name>/ starts only on a node that lists that folder (jobs.js), so process/js/pushOrigin/ must be listed on each node using it; it fits goal/G4.34's removeWhenDone.

OPEN: the shape; his Go.

checks.words: pushOrigin: take goalShare's way for both callers (commit the files onto origin's fetched tip, push, retry; the working tree is never touched), so publishData drops its pull --rebase? (wsl-claude)

chat.text:
taking: the red for G5.1.
publishData fixes by pull --rebase in the working tree; goalShare commits onto the fetched tip and never touches your checkout (desk.js 761, goalShare.js 52-74). One pushOrigin can only do the second for both.
wsl: the G5.1 red waits on your answer to its red question (goalShare's way for both, or not); written before it, it would guess the shape.

items.title: fileServer: one label per hash, no label arbitration

items.title: fileServer: slots the node reserves for itself (PROFILE_PICTURE)
items.box:
FILESERVER: SLOTS THE NODE RESERVES FOR ITSELF

ANDY, andy/NOFACE.md, VERBATIM
- "2. there will be slots in fileServer that are reserved by the node itself, like PROFILE_PICTURE."

OPEN: the shape; his Go.

checks.words: What is a node-reserved slot: a fixed name in fileServer (PROFILE_PICTURE) pointing at one file the node owns, set only by the owner, readable by every peer? And is PROFILE_PICTURE the only one for now? (claude-windows)

chat.text:
Go on all four noted. G5.1, G5.2 and G5.4 can be shaped from the tree and your words; G5.3 cannot yet: what is a node-reserved slot?
- a fixed name in fileServer (PROFILE_PICTURE) that points at one file the node owns, which only the owner can set and every peer can read?
- and is PROFILE_PICTURE the only one for now?

items.title: desk: the limbo state (Go consumed, nobody working, no Done, no open grant or question) visible and actionable for agents
items.box:
DESK: THE LIMBO STATE, VISIBLE AND ACTIONABLE

ANDY, andy/NOFACE.md, VERBATIM
- "when 'go' was pressed/consumed on an item, and no agent is working on that item, (all agents idle, ) and no 'Done' button is visible, no grants or red questions pending, then the item sits in 'limbo'. this limbo-state is actionable for agents.then an agent must 'take' that situation, add either a red grant request button, or a red question, or present a 'Done' button."

- 2026-10-05, after his stop: "none of your fault. it is part of my no-face views that desk should no longer be allowed to be idle without done buttons or grant asks or questions."

FOUND (claude-windows): every condition is already in an item's facts (go, done, claims, open G and Q checks, working agents), so limbo can be one more fact the List and the agents both read.

OPEN: the shape; his Go.
